composite_gate_b_corrective_contract.actions: ComputePathToPose và NavigateToPose dùng server_is_ready/send_goal_async, mỗi action đúng một lần; verdict derive từ calls/results/errors thực.
composite_gate_b_corrective_contract.escalation_reason: Owner phê duyệt L2 vì sửa lifecycle orchestration, clock/binding/TF, observer lifetime và scan validity; giữ tên decision L1 để không đổi path.
composite_gate_b_corrective_contract.gate_b_clock: use_sim_time=true ngay lúc create_node; goal stamps/freshness/TF dùng ROS simulation time; timer/deadlines dùng steady/monotonic; chưa clock hợp lệ không goal/sample; reject future stamps.
composite_gate_b_corrective_contract.gate_b_tf: Buffer(node=self.node), import tf2_geometry_msgs trước transform PoseStamped; chờ TF warm-up, không tạo sample giả.
composite_gate_b_corrective_contract.lifecycle_policy: Policy YAML được kiểm exact mapping rồi chuyển thành dictionary ROS; không truyền metadata policy qua --params-file.
composite_gate_b_corrective_contract.observer_overlap: Gate-B nhận --peer-evidence-path tới runtime_observer.json cùng invocation; atomic-write kết quả một lần, giữ node/subscriptions tới peer parse đủ và config_hash khớp. Chờ bằng steady deadline 60 giây, timeout/hash mismatch/interruption fail; không action retry.
composite_gate_b_corrective_contract.rearm: Runner chờ cả bảy ROS lifecycle Active id=3, clock/scan/filtered odometry fresh và TF map->odom->base_link trước đúng một service call. SafetyLifecycleState.PRIMARY_ACTIVE=2 không phải ROS lifecycle id=3.
composite_gate_b_corrective_contract.safety_lifecycle: LifecycleNode; handlers đăng ký trước node, configure sau process start, activate sau Inactive, mỗi handler một lần. Active vẫn NON_READY; không tự rearm.
composite_gate_b_corrective_contract.safety_startup: Jazzy Node đã khai báo use_sim_time; chỉ kiểm effective boolean true, không khai báo trùng và không catch-and-ignore.
composite_gate_b_corrective_contract.scan_validity: +Inf là valid no-return nếu metadata hợp lệ; NaN/-Inf/metadata sai/empty fail closed, stale scan safe stop. Không đổi command/odometry nonfinite checks, E-stop, limits hoặc collision ownership.

guard_mutation_exception_contract.atomic_replacement_boundary: Chỉ xóa lock khi strict runtime-guard readback bằng đúng seed PENDING, acquisition_count=0. CONSUMED hoặc readback không xác định phải giữ lock; không phục hồi capacity.
guard_mutation_exception_contract.pending_failure: Chỉ ghi pre-acquire/no-guard-consumed khi strict runtime readback đúng seed PENDING và không lock.
guard_mutation_exception_contract.runner_exception_readback: Sau mọi exception trong acquire/handoff/unmask, strict load chỉ runtime guard. CONSUMED phải khớp exact commit, integration base, authorization và acquisition_count=1 để vào post-acquire FAIL/teardown/terminal bundle.
guard_mutation_exception_contract.unknown_failure: Readback thiếu/hỏng/không khớp hoặc pending còn lock: FAIL với guard_acquired=null, guard_state_after=UNVERIFIED; giữ nguyên lock và không fallback sang source guard.

host_transport_host_preflight_contract.gazebo_transport_probe: gz topic -l with exact campaign GZ_PARTITION; no simulation process
host_transport_host_preflight_contract.interface_enumeration: socket.if_nameindex requires positive index and nonempty name
host_transport_host_preflight_contract.ros_discovery_cli_support_probe: Verify target CLI supports --no-daemon and --spin-time before bounded probe.
host_transport_host_preflight_contract.ros_discovery_probe: After ROS and overlay sourcing, run bounded ros2 topic list --no-daemon --spin-time 3 with campaign environment; empty graph is permitted; capability probe only, not runtime graph acceptance.
host_transport_host_preflight_contract.udp_probe: create/bind/close UDP socket on 127.0.0.1 without sending data

post_acquisition_sigterm_contract.handling: The handler is installed before acquisition. SIGTERM is blocked only during atomic guard acquisition/handoff; acquired state is marked before unblocking. Campaign interruption enters best-effort teardown; finalization latches signals without raising and resynchronizes a FAIL record/manifest/checksum before restoring the prior handler.
post_acquisition_sigterm_contract.sigkill_limit: SIGKILL cannot be caught; durable terminal record cannot be guaranteed if the process is forcibly killed, power is lost, or the evidence filesystem cannot write.

process_ownership_contract.group_verification: Chỉ killpg khi PID/PGID và ownership đã xác minh; recheck group của child còn sống trước signal. Group chưa xác minh chỉ được thử dừng chính child qua Popen handle; kết quả FAIL/unverified.
process_ownership_contract.handoff: Teardown lấy mọi child từ ownership ledger, kể cả khi caller assignment chưa hoàn tất. Call counts lấy từ ledger thực tế.
process_ownership_contract.registration: Cả bootstrap, composite, C++ observer và Gate-B observer dùng một owned-spawn helper. SIGTERM latch từ trước Popen đến khi child handle/member đã đăng ký; ledger giữ handle trước getpgid/snapshot.
process_ownership_contract.teardown_order: composite trước bootstrap; sau đó collectors. Child/PGID/snapshot lỗi không được báo clean hoặc PASS.

run005_attempt_002_invocation_005_dispos.external_termination_claim: NOT_ESTABLISHED_BY_PERSISTED_EVIDENCE; do not describe this invocation as lacking a final record.
run005_attempt_002_invocation_005_dispos.external_termination_prevented_record: NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_PERSISTED_ARTIFACT; run_record.json exists and records finalized teardown
host_transport_errors_observed_in_bootst: Error creating socket: Operation not permitted
run005_attempt_002_invocation_005_dispos.recorded_terminal_facts: Persisted run_record exists; it records BOOTSTRAP_READINESS_TIMEOUT after guard acquisition, bootstrap call count 1, composite and observers 0, teardown completed but not clean/order incorrect. Bootstrap log contains getifaddrs and socket Operation not permitted errors.

terminal_verdict_contract.best_effort_teardown: Stop and verify composite before bootstrap; continue cleanup after member failure. Any killpg, wait, /proc snapshot, or final process-group inspection uncertainty is unverified and FAIL, never clean.
terminal_verdict_contract.durability_limit: No durable record guarantee under SIGKILL, power loss, or a filesystem that cannot write.
terminal_verdict_contract.finalization_behavior: Verdict failures are represented as terminal FAIL records and do not raise FINAL_RECORD_INTERNAL_INCONSISTENCY. Filesystem/checksum failures remain distinct finalization failures; synchronize record, manifest and checksums after a caught finalization SIGTERM when writable.
terminal_verdict_contract.pass_requires: all acceptance values true AND no failure_reason_literals AND teardown completed, ordered composite-before-bootstrap, clean, and verified
terminal_verdict_contract.signal_handler: Install before pre-acquire checks and guard acquisition. SIGTERM before acquisition records a pre-acquire failure without claiming consumption. Block SIGTERM only over guard mutation/handoff with pthread_sigmask, mark the acquired state before unblocking, then route any pending signal into consumed FAIL handling. During campaign SIGTERM raises RUNNER_INTERRUPTED_BY_SIGNAL:SIGTERM; during teardown/finalization it latches without throwing, forces FAIL resynchronization through handler restoration, and the previous handler is restored exactly once.
